verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain docs explicitly state it can 'Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components' via dependency resolution, directly matching the SBOM story. However, the pack never names SPDX or CycloneDX as supported output formats, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of SBOM export working in practice. Missing for 10: explicit SPDX/CycloneDX format documentation, independent verification of SBOM output.
